name: Exclamation mark spacing
description: Flags a negation operator not followed by exactly one space. In a chained negation such as !!bReady, only the final ! requires a trailing space.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, a `!` negation operator not followed by exactly one space (e.g. `!bReady` or `!  bReady`), since a bit of breathing room makes the negation easier to spot. Never flags `!=`, which the lexer tokenizes separately, nor the gap between two directly adjacent `!`s in a chained/double negation (e.g. `!!bReady`) — only the last `!` in such a run needs its own trailing space. The fix inserts a space where there is none and collapses a longer run of spaces/tabs down to one.
